**Where it's opened**
- The button at `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html:9` (`.inv-btn`) calls `openInventory()`.
- `openInventory()` is at `game-console.component.ts:237`. It calls `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, …)` with `panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel'` and `maxHeight: '90vh'`.
- The `afterClosed()` handler at line 247 is empty, apart from a comment.

**Data passed in**
- The dialog data is an `InventoryDialogData`, defined in `inventory.component.ts:19`: `{ characterId: this.characterId, sessionId: this.sessionId }`.
- `InventoryComponent` reads it through `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.
- It only uses `characterId`. `sessionId` is never read in that component.
- It also reads the character signal from `CharacterStateService`, which isn't part of the dialog data.

**API calls it can make**
These go through `GameApiService` (`services/game-api.service.ts:89-102`):

| Component method | Service method | HTTP call |
|---|---|---|
| `loadInventory()`, run on init | `getInventory(characterId)` | `GET /api/character/:id`. It returns the whole character response and keeps only `.inventory`. |
| `toggleEquip(entry)` | `equipItem(characterId, itemId, equipped)` | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` with body `{ itemId, equipped }` |
| `dropItem(entry)` | `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` |
| `usePotion(entry)` | `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` | Same `DELETE` call as dropping an item |

- `usePotion` has no dedicated endpoint. It rolls the heal dice (`item.effect.heal`) on the client and then calls `dropItem` to consume the item. It updates HP only locally, through `charSvc.setCharacter({...char, hp: newHp})`, so the healing isn't saved to the server by this dialog.
- After each successful call, the component writes the returned `inventory` into its own signal and into `CharacterStateService.setInventory()`.

I didn't read the worker routes (`worker/src/routes/character.ts`), so I haven't checked the server side of these endpoints.
